units.source_text: 这位左大臣乃皇上所信任之人，且夫人是皇上的同胞妹妹，故在任何方面，都已高贵无比。

en.t: This Left Minister was a man deeply trusted by the emperor, and his wife was the emperor's own younger sister, so in every respect his rank was already surpassingly noble.

units.source_text: 今又招源氏公子为婿，声势更加显赫了。

en.t: Now that he had also taken Prince Genji as his son-in-law, his family's power and prestige became still more brilliant.

units.source_text: 右大臣是皇太子的外祖父，将来可能独揽朝纲。

en.t: The Right Minister was the crown prince's maternal grandfather and might one day hold the reins of government alone.

units.source_text: 可是现在相形见绌，势难匹敌了。

en.t: But now, by comparison, he seemed outshone and could hardly rival the other's influence.

units.source_text: 左大臣姬妾众多，子女成群。

en.t: The Left Minister had many ladies and concubines, and a great number of sons and daughters.

units.source_text: 正夫人所生的还有一位公子，现任藏人少将之职，

en.t: His principal wife had also borne him a son, who now served as a lesser captain of the imperial archives,

units.source_text: 长得非常秀美，是个少年英俊。

en.t: and he was exceptionally graceful and handsome, a fine young gentleman.

units.source_text: 右大臣本来与左大臣不睦，然而看中这位藏人少将，

en.t: Although the Right Minister had never been on good terms with the Left Minister, he took a liking to this young officer,

units.source_text: 竟把自己所钟爱的第四位女公子嫁给了他。

en.t: and actually gave him his beloved fourth daughter in marriage.

units.source_text: 右大臣的重视藏人少将，不亚于左大臣的重视源氏公子。

en.t: The Right Minister valued the young officer no less than the Left Minister valued Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 这真是世间无独有偶的两对翁婿！

en.t: They were truly two unparalleled pairs of fathers-in-law and sons-in-law in all the world.
